main_text.p: fecit,deterruit:Concutere,cōmovere,turbare,con-turbare , perturbare. Pahel זֵיעַ Idem. Ithpahel אִזְדַּעְזַע Tremere, contremiscere, comoveri. Sic Syrè, ܐܬܙܥ[?] Qui commoventur, agitantur, ad Ephes. 4.14. Ithpeh. אִתְזְיַע, Syr. ܐܬܙܥܙܥ[?] Moveri, commoveri, turbari, conturbari, perturbari, expavescere, contremiscere.
ܙܘܥܐ, ܙܘܥܐ Syr. Motio, commotio: Terræmotus, Matth.27.54.
זְיָא, זְיָע, & זְיַע Ch. Commotio, terræmotus, Amos 1.1. Item Pavor, tremor, terror, 1.Sam.11.7.
זַעֲזוּעַ Ch. Trepidatio, tremor, Genes.27.33. in Jon.
זְעָיָא, זַעֲוָא Ch. Idem. Ps.48.7. Jerem.25.30. & Jesa.21.3.
אִזְדַּעֲזוּעָא Ch. Motio, commotio, nutatio. Plur. constr. אִזְדַּעֲזוּעַת רִגְלָא Nutationes pedis. Job 12.5.
מְזִיעִין Ch. Terriculamenta, spectra, Dæmones sylvestres, Num.6.23. in T. Jon. Idem quod Hebraicum שְׂעִירִים : unde quidam derivant à מזיא, quod Pilum, Capillum significat, ut Hebraicum à שְׂעָר.
זוף Ch. Mutuari, mutuo accipere. Aphel אוֹדִיף Mutuare, mutuo dare, commodare: & quandoq; etiā, Mutuum accipere, ut Prov.22.7.
מוֹזְפָא Ch. Mutuum accipiens, Jesa.24.2. Item Mutuū dans, Fœnerator, Psal.109.11.
מוֹזְפַתָּא Ch. Mutuum, Creditum: מָרֵי מוֹזְפַתָּא Dominus crediti, Creditor, Deut.15.2.in Jon.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Aramaic forms were copied as best the scan allows; several vocalised words are uncertain and may differ in detail. Faint show-through from the facing page is ignored.
